name: OpenAmpere
description: Local app for solar systems with battery storage, no cloud at all.

paragraphs: Local app for solar systems with battery storage, no cloud at all.

OpenAmpere talks to the inverter directly on your home network, stores all data locally and shows it in the browser. On a smartphone you can add the page to the home screen, and it then behaves like an app. No account, no cloud, no dependence on a manufacturer's server.
The app's user interface and the website are in German.
features: Menu: Übersicht (Overview), Geräte (Devices: operate the battery, wallbox and immersion heater, and set the order in which they get solar power), Auswertung (Report) and Mehr (More: setup and settings). A switch „Nur…
Live energy flow for PV, house, grid and battery with state of charge, plus wallbox and immersion heater
Solar by module array: power, voltage and current per PV input (MPPT), e.g. for the south roof, west roof or garage
Power curve over the day with state of charge, values on tap

whatItDoes.text: Local app for solar systems with battery storage, no cloud at all.

requirements.text: No account, no cloud, no dependence on a manufacturer's server.

OpenAmpere supplies evcc with the grid, solar and battery readings, so evcc doesn't need its own connection to the inverter, and shows the charge points in the app: charging mode, charge target, minimum charge, charging plan, time until target and charging sessions.

If the car itself is set up in evcc, state of charge and range are added, and the report shows kilometres driven, kilometres on solar power, consumption per 100 km and cost per 100 km compared with grid power.
Changing settings, control commands and data backup require a login.
